name: Garzburn
original_name: ガルツベルン・ルク・ラルド
source:
A drakanoid who lives in a place called the Dragon's Nest near the top of the tower.

He has a long life, and has many items from the past. Drakanoids have conflicts with each other too, and it seems he is currently in a territorial argument with a rival.

[From [url=http://nisamerica.com/games/artonelico/]Ar Tonelico Official Site[/url]]
